title: Butkara III
subtitle: Minor stupa court on the Mingora outskirts, Lower Swat
road: unnamed asphalt town road (OSM tertiary 447689962), then residential streets to the site
edits: A bench up to 24 m wide is cut along the road to its smoothed profile (the 30 m DSM includes tree canopy).
Road bumps and ruts in the drive are illustrative; the grade and the line of the road are real.
Trees, shrubs, grass tufts and boulders are placed where WorldCover maps that cover; their size and number are illustrative.
The walking loop is a 30 m circle around the arrival point; it is not a mapped trail.

The stupas, the votive row and the shrine niches in the back wall are drawn from the Commons photos of Butkara III (CC BY-SA 3.0): their sizes are estimated, because no published dimensions for Butkara III were found.
The ground is not levelled (terrace 0): the court stands on the real slope from the DEM.
The stone courses, cobble inserts and the stepped mouldings are painted, not measured.
The 2859 buildings stand on their OSM footprints; their height (OSM levels where mapped, else one or two storeys), roofs and colours are illustrative, after visitors' photos.
Season colours, snow, ice and dawn mist are illustrative.

Traffic on the drive is illustrative: the vehicle kinds are those seen on Swat roads (Willys jeeps, Hilux, Suzuki vans, Mehran cars, CD70 motorbikes, Qingqi rickshaws, painted trucks); their number and movement are not counted.
